label_cost_rule: Only additional expert shooting is charged to improved imitation; public demonstrations share task preparation with every method.
comparison_scope: Validation development only; fixed unequal update budgets with actual costs reported, no tuned or held-out superiority claim.

costs.accounting: wall_time_s includes oracle_wall_time_s; each scalar objective query counts one requested full rollout, including failed queries. This is not a count of backend-internal replay solves.
